left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Unilateral ischemic stroke  [AND] with residual arm weakness (Fugl-Meyer Upper Limb < 60) more than 6 months prior to enrollment

right.raw_text: -  Ability to give informed consent and understand the tasks involved

left.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Hemorrhagic Stroke
  -  Contraindications to TMS: history of seizure/ [OR] epilepsy, [OR]  pacemaker, other neurological disorders, [OR]  brain surgery, [OR]  metal implant/ [OR] fragment in the head, pregnancy
  -  Taking medications  [OR] or substances that are known to affect PAS-induced plasticity within the past 2 months: selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors, [OR]  dopamine, [OR]  dopamine agonists, [OR]  haloperidol, [OR]  lithium, [OR]  acetylcholinesterase inhibitors, [OR]  beta-blockers, [OR]  nimodipine, [OR]  levetiracetam, [OR]  ethosuximide, [OR]  benzodiazepines, [OR]  baclofen, [OR]  nicotine
  -  Peripheral neuropathy  [OR] or history of nerve injury in the paretic upper limb

right.raw_text: -  Social  [OR] and/or personal circumstances that interfere with ability to return for all study visits
